page.layout: One page of text in a single column. A woodcut ornament stands in the middle of the page, between the text and the catchword. Running head with page number at the top. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: erwehlen / dann daß er verlasse das / so ich jetzt ge-sagt habe. Ganz armselig ist die Hoffart / unnd Ehrgeitz / davon sagt gar löblich Plato, daß die / so untereinander kriegen / welcher zu vörderst den gemeinen nuß regire / thun gleich wie die Schiffleut in einem ungewitter / so sich zancken umb das Ruder unnd Regierung des Schiffs.

page.notes: The page number "158" at the head is read from a small, worn old-style numeral and should be checked against the scan. The woodcut ornament between the text and the catchword is an image and is not transcribed. The catchword "CVR-" is the start of the next page's first word, printed with a hyphen. The line "Schiffs." is set centred and closes the paragraph. Printed u/v forms were normalised as instructed ("vnnd", "vmb", "vntereinander", "vngewitter"). The spelling "Ehrgeitz" and the line-end hyphen in "ge-sagt" are as printed.
